main_text.l: Epistolæ, quod est apud Oecumenium. Ἐπειδὴ καταηχηθέντες ὑπῆρχον οἱ ἐξ Ἰουδαίων, ὡς ἀποστασίαν διδάσκει Παῦλος, εἰκὸς τὰς γνωρίσαι [?] χάριν τὴν συμφωνίαν, Ἑβραίοις ἔγραψε. Quoniam audierant ex Judæis, quasi defectionem à Lege doceret Paulus, merito ut consensum prædicationis ostenderet, ad Hebræos scribit.

III. Neque exceptioni locus est quasi Pauli ex Schola, & discipulorum aliquo proficisci potuerit Epistola. i. Quia affirmare, quàm demonstrare facilius. ii. Quia referre ingenium Pauli, sublimem illam sapientiam, docendi modum, dictionem, perpetuam methodum, ne dicam authoritatè, vehementiâ, orationis illud flumen; ne etiam reponam circumstantias omnes supra Capitibus iii. iv. v. in antecessis ostensum. iii. Quia nata hæc Epistola, stante Templo & Levitico Sacerdotio, ὄντων τῶν ἱερέων, τῶν προσφερόντων [?] τὸν νόμον τὰ δῶρα, Hebr. viii 1.4. Neq; alias necesse fuerat declamare in sacrificiorum usu, & praxim sacerdotij, penitus eo, Templi & Urbis & Reipub. eversione, sublato. Neq; maximè

page.notes: The Greek line in the first paragraph and the Greek line after "Sacerdotio," are set in italic type; the Greek letters marked [?] are not clear on the scan. "Quoniam" is split across the line end with no printed hyphen, so it is written whole. The bold word at bottom right is the catchword "omni", read as shown. The "1." of the list is printed as a small i and is given as "i.". The Greek on the first line may contain errors I could not resolve with certainty.
